Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    varIsApprover,
    Navigate(Screen_WeeklyApprovals, ScreenTransition.Fade),
    Notify("No timesheets for approval.", NotificationType.Error)
)

If(
    varIsAdmin,
    Navigate(Screen_Settings, ScreenTransition.Fade),
    Notify("Settings are for admins only", NotificationType.Error)
)
"Week of " & Text(varCurrentWeekStart, "mmm d") & " - " & Text(DateAdd(varCurrentWeekStart, 6, "Days"), "mmm d, yyyy")

If(
    Mod(Round(Coalesce(Sum(colHoursGallery, Value(StandardHours)), 0), 2), 1) = 0,
    Text(Round(Coalesce(Sum(colHoursGallery, Value(StandardHours)), 0), 2), "0"),
    Text(Round(Coalesce(Sum(colHoursGallery, Value(StandardHours)), 0), 2), "0.##")
) & " hrs"
"Discard unsaved edits and reload this week"

Notify("Week regenerated. Unsaved changes cleared.", NotificationType.Warning);
Select(Button_LoadWeek);

If(
    Weekday(ThisItem.WorkDate, StartOfWeek.Monday) >= 6 ||
    ThisItem.TaskCode = "Weekend" ||
    ThisItem.TaskCode = "Stat. Holiday" ||
    Text(ThisItem.WorkDate, "yyyy-mm-dd") in ForAll(colPublic_Holidays, CleanDateKey),
    RGBA(240, 240, 240, 1),
    RGBA(255, 255, 255, 1)
)

If(ThisItem.ApprovalStatus = "Approved", RGBA(108, 212, 136, 1), ThisItem.ApprovalStatus = "Rejected", RGBA(252, 124, 124, 1), ThisItem.ApprovalStatus = "Pending", RGBA(252, 250, 124, 1), ThisItem.ApprovalStatus = "Draft", RGBA(200, 200, 200, 1), RGBA(0, 0, 0, 0))
If(ThisItem.ApprovalStatus = "Approved", DisplayMode.View, Or(ThisItem.TaskCode = "Work Day", ThisItem.TaskCode = "Weekend", IsBlank(ThisItem.TaskCode)), DisplayMode.Edit, DisplayMode.View)
["Work Day", "Weekend", "Stat. Holiday", "Vacation Paid", "Vacation Unpaid", "Sick Leave Paid", "Sick Leave Unpaid", "Bereavement", "Jury Duty", "Personal Day"]

Collect(
    colHoursGallery,
    {
        RowKey: Text(GUID()),
        WorkDate: ThisItem.WorkDate,
        DayLabel: ThisItem.DayLabel,
        CostCode: varSelectedCostCode,
        CostCodeID: varSelectedCostCodeID,
        TaskCode: "Work Day",
        Comments: "",
        StandardHours: "",
        IsSubmitted: false,
        RecordID: 0,
        ApprovalStatus: "",
        IsDirty: true
    }
)

ClearCollect(
    colExistingHours,
    ForAll(
        Filter(
            'Hours Tracking (Hours)',
            Employee = varSubmitAsEmail &&
            Date >= varCurrentWeekStart &&
            Date <= DateAdd(varCurrentWeekStart, 6, "Days")
        ),
        {
            SrcID: ID,
            SrcDate: Date,
            SrcCostCode: Cost_code,
            SrcTask: Task,
            SrcComments: Comments,
            SrcHours: Standard_time,
            SrcStatus: ApprovalStatus_1
        }
    )
);

ClearCollect(
    colHoursGallery,
    ForAll(
        colExistingHours As ExistingRow,
        {
            RowKey: Text(GUID()),
            WorkDate: DateAdd(ExistingRow.SrcDate, 0, "Days"),
            DayLabel: Text(DateAdd(ExistingRow.SrcDate, 0, "Days"), "ddd"),
            CostCode: ExistingRow.SrcCostCode,
            CostCodeID: LookUp(colCostCodes, Network_Activity_Name = ExistingRow.SrcCostCode).Network_Activity,
            TaskCode: If(
                !IsBlank(ExistingRow.SrcTask),
                ExistingRow.SrcTask,
                If(
                    IsBlank(ExistingRow.SrcComments),
                    "Work Day",
                    If(
                        Find(" | ", ExistingRow.SrcComments) > 0,
                        Left(ExistingRow.SrcComments, Find(" | ", ExistingRow.SrcComments) - 1),
                        ExistingRow.SrcComments
                    )
                )
            ),
            Comments: If(
                !IsBlank(ExistingRow.SrcTask),
                ExistingRow.SrcComments,
                If(
                    Find(" | ", ExistingRow.SrcComments & "") > 0,
                    Mid(ExistingRow.SrcComments, Find(" | ", ExistingRow.SrcComments) + 3, Len(ExistingRow.SrcComments)),
                    ""
                )
            ),
            StandardHours: If(Mod(Round(Coalesce(ExistingRow.SrcHours, 0), 2), 1) = 0, Text(Round(Coalesce(ExistingRow.SrcHours, 0), 2), "0"), Text(Round(Coalesce(ExistingRow.SrcHours, 0), 2), "0.##")),
            IsSubmitted: true,
            RecordID: ExistingRow.SrcID,
            ApprovalStatus: ExistingRow.SrcStatus,
            IsDirty: false
        }
    )
);

ForAll(
    Sequence(7, 0, 1),
    With(
        {
            currentDate: DateAdd(varCurrentWeekStart, Value, "Days"),
            isWeekend: Weekday(DateAdd(varCurrentWeekStart, Value, "Days"), StartOfWeek.Monday) >= 6,
            isHoliday: Text(DateAdd(varCurrentWeekStart, Value, "Days"), "yyyy-mm-dd") in ForAll(colPublic_Holidays, CleanDateKey)
        },
        If(
            IsEmpty(Filter(colExistingHours, DateAdd(SrcDate, 0, "Days") = currentDate)),
            Collect(
                colHoursGallery,
                {
                    RowKey: Text(GUID()),
                    WorkDate: currentDate,
                    DayLabel: Text(currentDate, "ddd"),
                    CostCode: If(
                        isWeekend || isHoliday,
                        "",
                        varSelectedCostCode
                    ),
                    CostCodeID: If(
                        isWeekend || isHoliday,
                        "",
                        varSelectedCostCodeID
                    ),
                    TaskCode: If(
                        isWeekend,
                        "Weekend",
                        isHoliday,
                        "Stat. Holiday",
                        "Work Day"
                    ),
                    Comments: "",
                    StandardHours: "",
                    IsSubmitted: false,
                    RecordID: 0,
                    ApprovalStatus: "",
                    IsDirty: false
                }
            )
        )
    )
);
